# ProPublica Projects

> Interactive databases and investigative tools exposing financial disclosures, government conflicts of interest, and public health risks across federal agencies and institutions.

ProPublica Projects hosts searchable databases and interactive analysis tools focused on government transparency, financial accountability, and investigative journalism. The site combines data visualization with in-depth reporting on Trump administration personnel, Supreme Court ethics, campaign finance, pharmaceutical safety, and environmental policy.

## Key Topics

- Trump administration
- Financial disclosures
- Conflict of interest
- Government transparency
- Campaign finance
- Supreme Court
- Executive branch
- Asset reporting
- Investigative journalism
- Trump appointees
- Government efficiency (DOGE)
- Generic drugs
- Election deniers
- Federal health workers
- Corporate donations

## Government Accountability & Financial Disclosures

- [Explore Financial Disclosures From President Trump and 1,500 of His Appointees](https://projects.propublica.org/trump-team-financial-disclosures): Database of Trump administration financial disclosures revealing conflicts of interest
- [Supreme Connections](https://projects.propublica.org/supreme-connections): Searchable database of Supreme Court justices' financial disclosures and gifts
- [The Key Figures Working Alongside Elon Musk at DOGE and in the Trump Administration](https://projects.propublica.org/elon-musk-doge-tracker): Tracker documenting Elon Musk and DOGE personnel in Trump administration
- [Look Up Which Fortune 500 Companies Fund Election Deniers](https://projects.propublica.org/fortune-500-company-election-deniers-jan-6): Database tracking Fortune 500 corporate donations to election denier politicians
- [527 Explorer](https://projects.propublica.org/527-explorer): Database exploring political 527 organization funding and spending patterns

## Public Health & Safety Tools

- [Where Was My Generic Prescription Drug Made? - Rx Inspector](https://projects.propublica.org/rx-inspector): Rx Inspector tool locates generic drug manufacturing sources and FDA inspection reports
- [Formaldehyde Cancer Risk in Your Neighborhood](https://projects.propublica.org/formaldehyde-cancer-risk-map): Interactive map showing formaldehyde cancer risk by neighborhood address
- [Claim File Helper](https://projects.propublica.org/claimfile): Free tool generating letters to request health insurance claim file records
- [Does Your Local Museum or University Still Have Native American Remains? — NAGPRA Database](https://projects.propublica.org/repatriation-nagpra-database): NAGPRA database searching institutions holding Native American remains

## Trump Administration Investigations

- [How Many Federal Health Workers Have RFK Jr. and the Trump Administration Cut?](https://projects.propublica.org/federal-health-worker-cuts-rfk-trump-administration): Analysis of 20,500+ federal health worker departures under Trump administration
- [Who Are the Venezuelan Immigrants Trump Sent to CECOT?](https://projects.propublica.org/venezuelan-immigrants-trump-deported-cecot): Investigation into Venezuelan immigrants deported to El Salvador's CECOT prison

## Constitutional Rights & Policy Analysis

- [Supreme Risk: An Interactive Guide to Rights the Supreme Court Could Take Away](https://projects.propublica.org/supreme-risk): Interactive guide to constitutional rights threatened by Supreme Court rulings
- [Private School Demographics](https://projects.propublica.org/private-school-demographics): Interactive tool comparing private school demographics to nearby public schools

## Homelessness & Urban Policy

- [Swept Away: What Cities Really Take When They Sweep Homeless Encampments](https://projects.propublica.org/homeless-encampment-sweeps-taken-belongings): Investigation of belongings seized in homeless encampment sweeps and impact
- [The Toll of Cities' Homeless Sweeps](https://projects.propublica.org/impact-of-homeless-sweeps-lost-belongings): Investigation of belongings lost during city homeless encampment sweeps

## Environmental & Resource Investigations

- [The 20 Farming Families Who Use More Water From the Colorado River Than Some Western States](https://projects.propublica.org/california-farmers-colorado-river): Investigation of farming families using disproportionate Colorado River water
- [Las Vegas Won't Save the Water It Needs by Just Removing Lawns](https://projects.propublica.org/turf-wars): Analysis of Nevada's overestimated lawn removal water conservation goals
- [How Forest Loss Can Unleash the Next Pandemic](https://projects.propublica.org/spillover): Investigation of forest loss and pandemic risk in West African Ebola region
